This page intentionally lacks structural HTML.

It is meant to exercise the Readability fallback path when no semantic article or main element is present.

Plain text considered harmful, considered considered, considered.

The third paragraph exists to push the body text past any sensible minimum length threshold so the extractor has something to chew on. Readability typically wants several hundred characters before it accepts a document as readable, so here is a longer paragraph to make sure that threshold is comfortably exceeded. The cat sat on the mat; the mat was made of strangely woven extension cords; the cords were unplugged, which is the only safe state for a power-cord mat.
